AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

17. In three clear sentences, explain Water Harvesting and Storage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen and Backyard Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
